transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Microsoft is optimizing Windows for Nvidia's Arm-based RTX Spark laptops, still open per The Verge, with gaming and memory support.
Confirmed by ZDNET: Nvidia launches three open-weight models to challenge Chinese artificial intelligence dominance with its new Nemotron 3.5 Super VL.
Reported by WOWT: A man was seriously injured by a car on Glendale road Thursday morning.
Opsin raises 21 million dollars led by SYN Ventures and Race Capital for artificial intelligence agent security, confirmed per Pulse 2.0.
Big Tech invests billions to build forward-deployed engineering workforces for artificial intelligence deployment, confirmed by CNBC, with AWS and Anthropic racing to prove spending will pay off.
Free every hour.
